newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Over 30 mln Corpgro shares sold offshore.
newsitem.headline: Over 30 mln Corpgro shares sold offshore.

text.p: Acquisitive industrial group Corpgro Ltd was the most active share on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Wednesday trading over 30 million shares in an overnight foreign deal.
Jeff Liebesman, Corpgro's chief executive, told Reuters the shares had been bought by an overseas institution.
"I understand that it is an offshore institution that has bought them...It's a very nice stake, but percentage wise it's no a big deal. (We have in issue) around 1.8 billion shares," Liebesman said.
A trader at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the brokerage that did the deal, said it had involved a foreign buyer and a local seller.
Corpgro shares ended steady at 34 cents, trading in between its year high and low of 46 cents and 25 respectively.
Corpgro has since last year blazed an acquisition trail, snapping up businesses in the hardware and building supply sector. It recently bought an outdoor signs group.
